name: Kyoto Street Directions
description: Kyoto's way of finding a town by its streets (通り名): the street the place is on, the cross street, and which way to go from the corner: 上ル or 上る (north), 下ル or 下る (south), 東入 (east) and 西入 (west), before the town itself. The town and block are the address; the directions are reported in streetDirections. Original case written for this corpuss; the shape is described in our own words from Kyoto City's own explanation of its addresses.
